_: Per-colour product photos read off the shops by hand and supplied as a spreadsheet, keyed like data/press.json: id -> slot -> url. These are SHOP photographs, not manufacturer press renders, which is why they are not in press.json - images/SOURCES.txt has to say truthfully where a picture came from. tools/photos.mjs treats them as one more candidate, so the 600px floor, the placeholder hashes and photo-rejects.json all still apply and the biggest candidate still wins. A slot is only recorded where the shop colour resolves to exactly one colour the product actually lists.
